raw_comment:
This graph displays all the droughts in America. I found the colors used for showing the scale to which drought's have been happening. I also found it interesting that Hawaii is almost completly colored, displaying its driness. I found this interesting because islands typically have a humid climate. I wonder why Hawaii has been experiencing a drought. Nearly the entire map of the US is covered in some color, which shows how dry it has been this fall. This relates to my community because this is the result of climate change, which effects every person in the world. Also, where I live, there has been very little rain in the past few months, which becomes very concerning. 
Headline: A thirst to be quenched when the first snow falls.
